website.data: --> North Texas Contractor | Alexander and Sons Roofing top of page Skip to Main Content Alexander and Sons Roofing 817-455-4745 Home Reviews Roofs Siding Windows Gutters Fences Contact Us More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. Our Services At Alexander and Sons Roofing we strive to provide quality work with honesty and integrity. Roof Inspections, Repairs, and Full Replacement Noticing water stains on your ceilings? See neighbors having their roof replaced after a recent storm? Just moving into a new home and insurance company needs to know the age of the roof? We are here to help you! All of our inspections will include a full report along with photos! We also offer drone inspections for those steep roofs. Recent Projects Window Replacement Are your old windows allowing cold and hot air in during the winter and summer months? Are the windows falling down on their own when you open them? If so, it might be time for us to come out for a free 30 minute consultation and measure your window openings to provide you an estimate for brand new replacement windows! We are not tied to one specific brand/style so we can quote the window that is best for you, your home, and your wallet! Recent Projects Siding Repairs and Replacement Siding is a great way to update or change the look of your home. However, often damaged siding from rotting wood, pesky critters, or storms can make siding repair or replacement unavoidable. Alexander and Sons roofing can work with you to make your home safe and beautiful. Recent Projects Metal Roof Installation From a metal accent to a complete metal roof. We can help from start to finish. Recent Projects Gutter Replacement Many times gutters are damaged in storms and need to be replaced. We can also install gutters on new homes, remodels, or additions. Gutters can help eliminate soil erosion that is damaging to the foundation. Recent Projects Wood Fences Missing pickets, faded stain, storm damage; these are all reasons for a fence makeover! A new fence can add privacy and curb appeal to your home. Recent Projects Who We Are Committed to Excellence Alexander and Sons Roofing is a local, family owned, trustworthy, and reputable Roofing Company serving the DFW area. We treat your family the way we would want to be treated! After having our 5th son, we decided it was time to start Alexander and Sons. My name is Justin Alexander and I have over 7 years experience in roofing. Our company is here for all your roofing, siding, replacement window, and outdoor living needs! Get in touch today to learn more about what we can offer you and receive your free estimate! ​ Meet the Team Owner Justin Alexander Since joining the industry in 2016, I have been at the forefront of all the latest products and techniques. Alexander and Sons Roofing is able to offer a wide range of services to handle all our clients’ needs. From simple roof repairs to full exterior remodels, we do it all at the most competitive rates on the market. ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ Alexanderandsonsroofing@gmail.com 972-658-9231 Phone Sales Dean Tenneson Dean joins our team at Alexander and Sons Roofing bringing his knowledge of roof structures from his main job as a firefighter with the DFW Airport Fire Department. He also has 18 years of construction experience. Dean is married to his beautiful wife Courtney, and they are joining the all boy club as they welcome their 3rd son! With Dean you can expect a great experience with his knowledge, integrity, and genuine character. Dean can also help with your Christmas light installation. Give him a call today for a free estimate. Dean@weroofntx.com 817-723-9535 Phone Sales Mike Riley Mike Riley brings 8 years of roofing experience, but a passion for helping people that you just can't quantify. Mike is married to his beautiful wife Stephanie and helping to even out the girls vs. boys at Alexander and Sons with his 2 beautiful daughters. Mike is honest, knowledgable, and will do whatever it takes to help someone in need. He is a true asset to our team. Give him a call today if you need a roofer that will go above and beyond. ​ ​ Mike@weroofntx.com 682-274-1519 Phone Sales James Russell James joins our team bringing a "major league" focus on integrity and customer service! Although he is new to the industry, his work ethic and customer service are unmatched! He will be our "claim to fame" as he played major league baseball for 14 years! He still currently coaches youth baseball and gives private lessons on the side. James is here to help you with all your roofing and home exterior projects. James@weroofntx.com 817-247-2060 Phone Marketing Angela Alexander Angela spends most of her time as the CEO of the Alexander household, but also manages the marketing, sales, and office duties at Alexander and Sons Roofing. ​ ​ ​ ​ Alexanderandsonsroofing@gmail.com 817-455-4745 Phone Contact 817-455-4745 Submit Thanks for submitting! reviews.text: This is our second time using Alexander & Sons. Last year, they did a great job replacing all our windows so when we discovered a hole in our roof we called them right away. They quickly did a temp repair and then were able to come back right away to replace the roof. Justin and Dean were great to work with! The new roof looks great! Job site was cleaner than it was before they came. Definitely recommend for windows or roofing.
reviews.author: Malaika Farmer

reviews.text: Working with Justin and team has been great. They’ve done some brick and mortar repair as well as gutter install for us. We are very pleased with the work. Communication, quality, and the price was much better than other companies we’ve had out for various projects.
reviews.author: Luke Heaton

reviews.text: Justin, the owner of Alexander and Sons Roofing, is very knowledgeable, trustworthy, professional, and courteous. My husband and I interviewed many roofers before deciding to hire Justin. He guided us through the process from start to finish and was very responsive every time we had a question. We now have a beautiful new metal roof, and we couldn't be happier. Finding a roofer can be a daunting process. I recommend Alexander and Sons Roofing if you want to receive a quality roof at a fair price with excellent customer service.
reviews.author: Jill M.

reviews.text: Alexander & Sons replaced our steel roof after storm damage. Justin was thorough with wonderful to work with! He was diligent with our insurance adjuster which made the process much easier for us. The team that worked on the roof was respectful, efficient and the roof/gutters look great!
reviews.author: Vanessa Patchen

reviews.text: Justin is the owner and he is honest and straightforward to deal with. Work completed in a timely manner and with utmost quality. I wouldn’t hesitate to do other general contact works. They are much beyond a roofing company.
reviews.author: Srinivas Somisetty

reviews.text: Justin and his team were amazing the whole way through the process. When early spring storms knocked down our fence, I didn’t hesitate to call Justin to have him quote the project as well as replacing old windows on the back of the house. May vision of even being able to leave room to expand the driveway was communicated very clearly with the crew.I already have future projects in mind and Justin is the only person I’ve plan to reach out to.
reviews.author: Heather Nixon

reviews.text: Mike and the team at Alexander & Sons made what could be a difficult process so easy to accomplish. They walked us through every step of the process, from inspection to estimates to negotiating with insurance, to complete roofing. We could not have been more satisfied with the workmanship, the thoroughness, or the friendliness. I will recommend them to everyone!
reviews.author: Randy Johnson

reviews.text: Anderson and Sons handled every aspect of my roof replacement. Justin communicated every step. His crew did great work and kept the site clean. They were a pleasure to work with. There were no surprises. I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Todd Wylie
